# We Are So Pro

We Are So Pro is a self-published Canadian comedy fiction book about a group of adult beer-league hockey players who take their early-morning 6:30 AM pickup sessions far too seriously. The book follows a team called the Early Birds through a season of games, banter, penalties, and the kind of deep friendship that only comes from freezing in an ice rink before the rest of the world wakes up.

It is available on Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0G2FLQ76Z

## About the book

- **Full title:** We Are So (Mediocre) Pro
- **Genre:** Adult comedy fiction, sports fiction, Canadian fiction
- **Setting:** A fictional Canadian city, adult recreational hockey league
- **Theme:** Adult friendship, the absurdity of competitive spirit in non-competitive settings, and what it means to keep showing up
- **Format:** Multiple print editions (designed to function like different versions of a game release), plus eBook

The book started as weekly recap emails sent to teammates who missed games. The author began thinking: "This would've been such a great premise for an anime — sports, but not about teenagers, not about special talent. Just older people with jobs trying to enjoy themselves." That thought eventually became a book.

## Characters

- **Stanley** — The forward who chirps as much as he skates. Known for making mom jokes to his actual boss. Three-time Wednesday league champion. Competes with Tommy in the Wednesday night circuit.
- **Tommy the Goalie** — The team's goalie. Has a losing record in championship finals despite being technically solid. Stayed up until 4 AM reading the finished book the night before a game.
- **Don** — The consistent winner. Three championship titles in Stanley's Wednesday league.
- **Dale** — Retired. Now drives a school bus. Meticulous enough to count every character mention in the finished book.
- **Joe** — The penalty specialist. Accumulates PIMs he probably didn't deserve.
- **Karen** — Did not appreciate her anonymized name at first. Her family had to explain it. The author now calls her Karen just for fun.
- **Brent** — Took over team finances. Reliable in all the ways that matter.
- **Jack** — Called the "Sniper" in the book. Became the leading scorer in the league.
- **Percy** — Team philosopher. Motto: "We skate, we hydrate."
- **Aiden** — One of the younger Early Birds. Stanley attempted a toedrag on him in their first matchup.
- **Ricky, Mike, Pete, Rob, Stephanie** — Additional Early Birds, all based on real members of the group.

All characters are based on real people. Location names and rink names are fictionalized to protect the group's identity.

## Notable quotes from the book and characters

Stanley, on the philosophy of adult recreational hockey:
> "Every hockey session means one less session for the rest of my life."

Stanley, to a teammate after a particularly inspired jump:
> "Parkour! Parkour!"

Stanley, on the existential stakes of a long weekend meeting:
> "I've already spent my weekend on this. Can't back out now."

The author, on discovering what he had written:
> "This is what you said was good? Are you kidding?"

The author, on why the book exists:
> "It's about older people with jobs, just trying to enjoy themselves."

## Frequently asked questions

**Are the characters real?**
Yes. Every character is based on someone in the group. The sequence of events isn't necessarily true to actual events, and some characters may be composites — but the stories were mostly inspired by real things that happened.

**How much of the book was AI-generated?**
None of the actual text. AI was used in consultation. Out of all suggestions made, the author took maybe 5% — and even then, only a few words or phrases, or rephrased it entirely. The author's literary style was apparently distinctive enough that AI refused to generate text that sounded like him.

**Why was the book written?**
A teammate couldn't make a game and asked how it went. The author responded "It was 4-1" — then paused dramatically until revealing the team won 5-4 in the last minute. The team made him write recaps every week after that. Writing a book felt like a natural next step.

**Do they really play at 6:30 AM?**
Yes. They've been doing it long enough that it feels normal.

The companion site at wearesopro.ca provides bonus content beyond the book:

- **Home:** https://wearesopro.ca — About the book, author's origin story, buy links

- **Games & Quizzes:** https://wearesopro.ca/games.html — Interactive character games (quote matching, character identification, Tommy the Goalie simulator)
- **Buy on Amazon:** https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0G2FLQ76Z

## Intended audience

Readers who enjoy: adult comedy fiction, Canadian sports culture, beer-league hockey, found-family stories, books about middle-aged adults refusing to act their age, behind-the-scenes companion content, interactive book experiences.
